name: sqlprojectreader-wildcard-case-folding
body: Pattern compiles a wildcard item spec into a case-insensitive, culture-invariant regular expression, while literal specs compare ordinal-ignore-case, so the two can disagree only on unusual non-ASCII letter casing. Upgrade to a hand-rolled ordinal-ignore-case wildcard matcher if a project path ever needs exact ordinal behaviour for wildcards.
